replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, especially when the math gets complex or abstract. My anxiety tends to spike with topics like calculus or higher-level algebra. But I manage it by taking breaks and focusing on practical applications.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used a simple AI tool last year to check my homework answers. It helped clarify concepts but wasn’t perfect—sometimes it gave unclear explanations. Overall, it was a helpful supplement but not a replacement for understanding.
